newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel B dips 5.20 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel B dips 5.20 pct in late trade.

text.p: Food and beverage company San Miguel Corp shed five pesos, or 5.20 percent, to 91 pesos in late trade on Tuesday as brokers said investors were concerned about the intense competition in the soft drinks market.
"Investors are wary that competition in the cola sector will cause a dip in prices and result in lower bottomline for the company," said Jonas Ferrer, vice-president at Pryce Securities.
San Miguel owns 70 percent of Coca-Cola Bottlers Philippines Inc and the remaining 30 percent is held by the Coca-Cola Company.
